question: Indian origin _________, was United Kingdom's Home Secretary until November 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suella Braverman**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Suella Braverman** of Indian origin was the United Kingdom's Home Secretary until November 2023.
 
• She was appointed to this position by Prime Minister **Rishi Sunak**.
 
• Suella Braverman is a member of the **Conservative Party** and has been serving as a Member of Parliament (MP) since 2015.
 
• As Home Secretary, she was responsible for overseeing the internal affairs of England and Wales, including **immigration, security, and law and order**.
 
• Her tenure was marked by significant policies on **immigration control and national security**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suella Braverman** was born to Indian parents who migrated to the UK in the 1960s.
 
• She studied law at **Queen's College, Cambridge**, and completed her master's degree at the **Université Panthéon-Sorbonne**.
 
• Before entering politics, she worked as a **barrister specializing in public law and judicial review**.
 
• She has also served as the **Attorney General for England and Wales** before being appointed as the Home Secretary.
 
• Her policies and decisions as Home Secretary have had a significant impact on the UK’s legal and immigration systems.
